enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Nightshade Venom: Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a Difficulty Check 22 Fortitude save or fall unconscious. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the sleep lasts for 20 seconds.

Poison Burst: This weapon is dripping with poison, and deals 1 to 6 poison damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 poison damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Bleed: This weapon is cruelly sharp and will do an additional 1 to 8 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

Constitution Poison, Virulent: The deadly poison coating this weapon deals one point of constitution damage every time it strikes an enemy, and an additional 1 to 6 points of constitution damage when it scores a critical hit. Some creatures may be immune or resistant to ability damage.

Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +3 : Provides a +3 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +5 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
